item.description:
### Added - **Jump-to-terminal lands on the right tmux pane.** Clicking a session that runs inside tmux used to raise the right terminal app but leave the multiplexer on whatever window it was showing. Perch now tells the tmux server to select the agent's window and pane first — verified against the live process, so a recycled process id can never focus a stranger's pane — and then raises the terminal that actually hosts the tmux client, even though tmux masks it.
### Fixed - **Codex installed through asdf is found again.** Current asdf (0.16 and later) writes shims that call `asdf` by name, which a Mac app's minimal environment cannot find — so an asdf-managed Codex silently didn't resolve, and Perch's Codex features stayed off. Perch now also puts asdf's own location on the path when probing a shim, for both asdf generations.
